title: When Does Combining Software-Effort Estimates Help? Evidence from Four Public Project Datasets
abstract: arXiv:2611.06948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combining estimates can reduce individual prediction errors, but an ensemble may also dilute an unusually accurate estimator or repeat errors shared by its members. We study these competing effects on four archival software-effort datasets (Kitchenham: 145 projects, Desharnais: 77, China: 499, Maxwell: 63) with 100 repeated 70/30 training and test partitions per dataset. Three conventional models (parametric regression, analogy, and random forest) are combined with each other and, in Kitchenham, with a recorded human estimate. Out-of-fold calibration errors drive five combination rules: equal weighting, inverse-MSE weighting, a nonnegative simplex combination, signed Bates-Granger weighting, and Bates-Granger with covariance shrinkage. All preprocessing is learned within training folds. Model-error correlations range from 0.54 to 0.97. In Kitchenham, the human estimate dominates: equal weighting raises mean test log-MAE from 0.239 to 0.4

translated_title: 何时组合软件工作量估计才有帮助？来自四个公开项目数据集的证据
translated_abstract: 组合估计可以降低单个预测的误差，但集成也可能稀释一个异常准确的估计器，或重复其成员共同犯下的错误。我们在四个历史软件工作量数据集（Kitchenham：145个项目、Desharnais：77个、China：499个、Maxwell：63个）上研究这些相互竞争的效应，每个数据集采用100次重复的70/30训练与测试划分。三种传统模型（参数回归、类比估计和随机森林）相互组合，并在Kitchenham数据集中与已记录的人工估计相结合。五种组合规则由折外校准误差驱动：等权重加权、逆MSE加权、非负单纯形组合、带符号的Bates-Granger加权，以及带协方差收缩的Bates-Granger加权。所有预处理均在训练折内学习。模型误差相关性介于0.54至0.97之间。在Kitchenham数据集中，人工估计占主导地位：等权重组合使平均测试log-MAE从0.239上升到0.4……
tldr: 本文在四个公开软件工作量数据集上系统比较五种组合规则后发现，组合估计并非总是有益——当某一估计（尤其是人工估计）异常准确或各成员误差高度相关时，集成反而会稀释准确性或重复共同误差。
en_tdlr: Using four public software-effort datasets and five combination rules, this study shows that combining estimates only helps when no estimator dominates; when a human estimate is unusually accurate or members' errors are highly correlated, ensembles dilute accuracy or repeat shared mistakes.
